Language can be changed in game settings

gameDescriptionHtml:
A deadly virus is spreading across Los Angeles, turning its inhabitants into zombies. Bitten, infected, but more than just immune, uncover the truth behind the outbreak and discover who – or what – you are. Survive, evolve and become the ultimate Zombie Slayer.

Game Features

  • NEW WAYS TO SLAY – Join the Bobcats, in a new co-op horde mode! And continue your adventure in New Game+, featuring new zombies, abilities, weapons and more!
  • EXPLORE HELL-A – Dead Island 2 takes players across the most iconic locations of the City of Angels, in an exciting pulp journey from the lavish suburbia of Beverly Hills to the quirky promenade of Venice Beach.
  • BRUTAL MELEE SANDBOX – Combat delivers the most intense, visceral and gory first person experience possible, using the most advanced dismemberment system ever seen. Whether you’re slicing, smashing, burning or ripping, we want you to truly feel it.
  • ZOMBIE INFESTATION – These mutated wretches are the reanimated, rotten heart of Dead Island 2 with dozens of distinct zombie types, each with their own mutations, attacks and hundreds of visual LA-themed variants.
  • MAJESTIC MELEE MODS – Visit workbenches to craft outrageous weapon mods with unique properties. Create flaming katanas, explosive sledgehammers, electrified claws and much, much more.
  • A CINEMATIC CO-OP ADVENTURE – There are plenty of exciting quests, a crazy cast of characters, and a thrilling pulp story, to truly immerse you in its twisted universe. Add an over-the-top co-op mode for up to three players, and you’ll stay in LA for a very long (and gory) trip.

Included DLCs:

  • Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Weapons Pack
  • Memories of Banoi Pack
  • Golden Weapons Pack
  • Pulp Weapons Pack
  • Red’s Demise Katana
  • Character Pack: Silver Star Jacob
  • Character Pack: Cyber Slayer Amy
  • Character Pack: Gaelic Queen Dani
  • Character Pack: Jungle Fantasy Ryan
  • Character Pack: Steel Horse Carla
  • Character Pack: Venice Vogue Bruno
  • Haus
  • SoLA
  • PROS Items (via Unlocker)
